title: BBC Learning English from the News 2024 — Quiz 2
description: Choose the best answer for each question about vocabulary and usage.

elements.name: q11_send_chill_through
elements.title: The sound of footsteps in the empty building sent a chill through Maya. What did it do?
choices: Made Maya want to turn down the heating

elements.name: q12_hedonistic
elements.title: The novel portrays a hedonistic lifestyle. Which description fits?
choices: A life devoted to helping others
A life centred on saving every spare penny
A life centred on pursuing pleasure without restraint
A life guided by strict self-discipline
elements.correctAnswer: A life centred on pursuing pleasure without restraint

elements.name: q13_where_do_things_stand
elements.title: A colleague asks, “Where do things stand with the repairs?” What do they want to know?
choices: Where to store the spare parts

elements.name: q14_parting_gift
elements.title: On his last day, his colleagues gave him a parting gift. Why was the gift given?

elements.name: q15_ratchet_something_up
elements.title: The organisers gradually ratcheted up the pressure. What happened to the pressure?
choices: It returned to its starting level.

elements.name: q16_choke
elements.title: Thick smoke made the hikers choke. What happened?
choices: They lost their sense of direction.

elements.name: q17_hit_new_highs
elements.title: Online sales hit new highs this month. What does that mean?
choices: They returned to their usual level.
They reached a higher level than ever before.
They met a target set several years ago.
They rose briefly but stayed below the previous record.
elements.correctAnswer: They reached a higher level than ever before.

elements.name: q18_blurred_lines
elements.title: The app has blurred the lines between work and leisure. What has it done?
choices: Made work and leisure easier to schedule
Made work and leisure harder to distinguish
Made work and leisure equally popular
Made work more expensive than leisure
elements.correctAnswer: Made work and leisure harder to distinguish

elements.name: q19_jubilant
elements.title: Which word best completes the sentence? “The players were ___ after winning the final and celebrated all night.”

elements.name: q20_close_in_on
elements.title: With only one win left to secure the championship, the team is closing in on the title. What does that mean?
choices: It is getting further from winning it.
It is getting closer to winning it.
elements.correctAnswer: It is getting closer to winning it.
